aristotle:anal-post.author: Aristotle
aristotle:anal-post.note: Classical theory of demonstrative science (episteme) contrasted by Hoenen (Caput V § 1.2) with Hilbert's formal axiomatics.

de-zolt:1881.author: Antonio De Zolt
de-zolt:1881.note: Formulates the polygonal area postulate (Euclid C.N. 5 for dissection) proved deductively by Hilbert as Theorem 30 in § 20.

dehn:1900.author: Max Dehn
dehn:1900.locus: Nachrichten von der Königl. Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, Math.-phys. Klasse, pp. 345–354 (and Math. Annalen, Bd. 55, 1901, pp. 465–478)
dehn:1900.note: Solves Hilbert's Third Problem, proving that tetrahedra of equal base and altitude need not be equidecomposable or equicomplementable—cited by Hilbert in the 1900/1902 Conclusion.

dehn:1900:legendre.author: Max Dehn
dehn:1900:legendre.work: Die Legendre'schen Sätze über die Winkelsumme im Dreieck
dehn:1900:legendre.note: Göttingen doctoral dissertation under Hilbert constructing non-Legendrian and non-Archimedean geometries.

euclid:elements.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:elements.locus: Books I, V, VI, X, XI
euclid:elements.publisher: Critical ed. J. L. Heiberg (Teubner, 1883–1888); English ed. T. L. Heath (Cambridge, 1908)
euclid:elements.note: Foundational Greek treatise whose axioms, congruence proofs, proportion theory, polygonal area theorems, and straightedge-and-compass constructions Hilbert reconstructs throughout §§ 1–39.

frege:1903.author: Gottlob Frege
frege:1903.locus: Jahresbericht der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung, Bd. 12, pp. 319–324, 368–375
frege:1903.note: Public continuation of the 1899–1900 Frege–Hilbert correspondence debating implicit definitions, consistency, and geometric truth.

freudenthal:1957.author: Hans Freudenthal
freudenthal:1957.work: Zur Geschichte der Grundlagen der Geometrie (Zugleich eine Besprechung der 8. Aufl. von Hilberts 'Grundlagen der Geometrie')
freudenthal:1957.locus: Nieuw Archief voor Wiskunde (3), Vol. 5, pp. 105–142
freudenthal:1957.note: Definitive historical and mathematical retrospective on Hilbert's 1899 Grundlagen and its evolution through subsequent editions.

hardy:1929.author: Godfrey Harold Hardy
hardy:1929.locus: Mind, New Series, Vol. 38, No. 149, pp. 1–25
hardy:1929.note: Quoted by Hoenen (Caput V § 3.2.B, fn. 9) on the indispensable intuitive role of spatial symbol order and geometric figures in Hilbert's axiomatics.

heath:1908.author: Sir Thomas Little Heath
heath:1908.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements, Translated from the Text of Heiberg with Introduction and Commentary
heath:1908.note: Primary commentary in GEOMETOR euclid analyzing Hilbert's Congruence Axioms, SAS proof, right-angle congruence (Post. 4), continuity, and area dissection.

helmholtz:1868.author: Hermann von Helmholtz
helmholtz:1868.work: Über die Thatsachen, die der Geometrie zum Grunde liegen
helmholtz:1868.locus: Nachrichten von der Königl. Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, pp. 193–221
helmholtz:1868.note: Initiated the group-theoretic free-mobility characterization of space revisited by Sophus Lie and by Hilbert in the 1902 Appendix.

hilbert:1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1899.work: Grundlagen der Geometrie (Festschrift zur Feier der Enthüllung des Gauss-Weber-Denkmals in Göttingen, Erster Theil)
hilbert:1899.note: First German edition digitized in verbatim archival full text for the Deutsch track of this Book Codex.

hilbert:1900:french.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1900:french.work: Les principes fondamentaux de la géométrie (traduit par L. Laugel)
hilbert:1900:french.locus: Annales scientifiques de l'École Normale Supérieure (3), Tome 17, pp. 103–209 (and separate monograph)
hilbert:1900:french.note: Authorized French edition introducing the Axiom of Completeness (Vollständigkeit) in § 8 and Dehn's polyhedra note in the Conclusion.

hilbert:1900:zahlbegriff.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1900:zahlbegriff.locus: Jahresbericht der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung, Bd. 8, pp. 180–184
hilbert:1900:zahlbegriff.note: Companion axiomatization of the real number continuum pairing Archimedes's Axiom with the Axiom of Completeness.

hilbert:1902:en.author: David Hilbert (trans. E. J. Townsend)
hilbert:1902:en.publisher: The Open Court Publishing Company, Chicago
hilbert:1902:en.note: Authorized English translation forming the verbatim English track of this Book Codex.

hilbert:1902:lie.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1902:lie.note: Topological characterization of the Euclidean and hyperbolic planes via Jordan curves and transformation groups without differentiability; summarized in Townsend's 1902 Appendix.

hilbert:1930.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1930.work: Grundlagen der Geometrie (Siebente umgearbeitete und vermehrte Auflage)
hilbert:1930.note: Definitive lifetime revision by Hilbert, cited by Peter Hoenen in De Noetica Geometriae (1954).

hoenen:1954.author: Petrus Hubertus Jacobus Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen:1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen:1954.locus: Analecta Gregoriana, Vol. LXIII (Caput I § 6, Caput IV Prelim., Caput V §§ 1–5)
hoenen:1954.note: Epistemological treatise in GEOMETOR hoenen critically examining Hilbert's primitive terms, Erklärungen, linear order axioms, and completeness postulate.

jordan:1893.author: Camille Jordan
jordan:1893.work: Cours d'analyse de l'École Polytechnique (2e édition)
jordan:1893.note: Locus classicus of the Jordan curve theorem cited in § 4 (polygon separation) and the 1902 Appendix.

kant:1781.author: Immanuel Kant
kant:1781.work: Kritik der reinen Vernunft (Critique of Pure Reason)
kant:1781.note: Source of Hilbert's epigraph: 'So fängt denn alle menschliche Erkenntniss mit Anschauungen an, geht von da zu Begriffen und endigt mit Ideen.'

killing:1893.author: Wilhelm Killing
killing:1893.work: Einführung in die Grundlagen der Geometrie
killing:1893.note: Comprehensive treatise on space forms and non-Archimedean/group-theoretic foundations cited by Hilbert in § 12.

lie:1893.author: Sophus Lie (bearbeitet von Friedrich Engel)
lie:1893.work: Theorie der Transformationsgruppen, Dritter und letzter Abschnitt
lie:1893.locus: Abtheilung V: Untersuchungen über die Grundlagen der Geometrie, pp. 393–543
lie:1893.note: Lie's analytic solution of the Riemann–Helmholtz problem cited by Hilbert in the Introduction and Appendix.

moore:1902.author: Eliakim Hastings Moore
moore:1902.work: On the Projective Axioms of Geometry
moore:1902.locus: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society, Vol. 3, No. 1, pp. 142–158
moore:1902.note: Proved that Hilbert's 1899 linear order Axiom II 4 is redundant (deducible from planar incidence I 1–2 and Pasch's Axiom II 5), cited by Townsend (§ 3 fn.) and Hoenen (Caput V § 3.2.A).

pappus:synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge.locus: Book VII, Propositions 138–139 (ed. F. Hultsch, Vol. II, 1877, pp. 882–886)
pappus:synagoge.note: Original Greek locus of Pappus's Hexagon Theorem—the degenerate conic theorem Hilbert calls 'Pascal's Theorem' (Pascalscher Satz) in Chapters III and VI.

pasch:1882.author: Moritz Pasch
pasch:1882.note: First rigorous axiomatization of linear and planar order; source of Hilbert's Axiom II 5 ('Pasch's Axiom') in § 3.

peano:1891.author: Giuseppe Peano
peano:1891.work: Die Grundzüge des geometrischen Calculs (trans. A. Schepp) & I principii di geometria logicamente esposti
peano:1891.note: Symbolic axiomatization of geometric segments and vector calculus cited in Hilbert's Introduction and § 3.

poincare:1902.author: Henri Poincaré
poincare:1902.locus: Bulletin des sciences mathématiques (2), Tome 26, pp. 249–272
poincare:1902.note: Classic philosophical and mathematical review of Hilbert's Grundlagen.

russell:1903.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1903.locus: Part VI: Space, Ch. XLVI, p. 405
russell:1903.note: Critique of Euclidean superposition quoted by Heath on Euclid I.4 alongside Hilbert's Axiom IV 6.

schur:1898.author: Friedrich Schur
schur:1898.work: Über den Fundamentalsatz der projectiven Geometrie
schur:1898.note: Spatial metric proof of Pascal's/Pappus's Theorem without Archimedes's Axiom cited by Hilbert in § 14.

sommer:1900.author: Julius Sommer
sommer:1900.locus: Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society, Vol. 6, pp. 287–299
sommer:1900.note: Early Göttingen review of Hilbert's Festschrift; Sommer's 3D independence model for IV 6 is cited by Hilbert in § 11.

steiner:1833.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner:1833.work: Die geometrischen Constructionen, ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und eines festen Kreises
steiner:1833.note: Poncelet–Steiner fixed-circle theorem generalized and refined by Hilbert in Chapter VII (§§ 36–39).

stolz:1894.author: Otto Stolz
stolz:1894.work: Die ebenen Vielecke und die Winkel mit Einschluss der Berührungswinkel als Systeme von absoluten Grössen
stolz:1894.locus: Monatshefte für Mathematik und Physik, Jahrg. 5, pp. 233–240
stolz:1894.note: Cited by Hilbert in § 12 and § 18 on non-Archimedean magnitudes and polygon area equivalence.

veronese:1894.author: Giuseppe Veronese
veronese:1894.work: Grundzüge der Geometrie von mehreren Dimensionen und mehreren Arten gradliniger Einheiten in elementarer Form entwickelt (trans. A. Schepp)
veronese:1894.locus: Leipzig (Italian original: Fondamenti di geometria, Padova, 1891)
veronese:1894.note: Synthetic investigation of non-Archimedean geometry cited by Hilbert in § 12.

wiener:1891.author: Hermann Wiener
wiener:1891.work: Über Grundlagen und Aufbau der Geometrie / Weiteres über Grundlagen und Aufbau der Geometrie
wiener:1891.locus: Jahresbericht der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung, Bd. 1 (1891), pp. 45–48; Bd. 3 (1893), pp. 70–80
wiener:1891.note: Proposed Desargues's and Pascal's (Pappus's) theorems as incidence-based foundations of projective geometry, directly motivating Hilbert's Chapters III, V, and VI.
